what_they_do: Continuum is an AI platform for financial advisors that captures and transcribes client meetings without needing a bot on the call, then combines that with email and CRM data to keep a running client profile with suggested follow-up tasks. It replaces the manual work of an advisor typing up meeting notes, updating the CRM by hand, and drafting client recap emails after every conversation.
theme_fit_rationale: Continuum embeds directly into advisor-client conversations (meetings, emails) to build a client intelligence system of record, which is the exact wedge Theme 8 describes under its wealth management use case. It also syncs across CRM and practice-management systems (EquiSoft, Mako, VieFUND, Learnedly, Egnite) to auto-generate follow-up tasks, which echoes Theme 2's cross-system workflow pattern as a secondary fit.

Hey Daniel - Know I've reached out a couple times but wanted to see if now is a better time. I help lead our vertical AI investing at Telescope, a $275M Series A fund started by a former Sequoia partner. We lead $5-30M Series A investments in a handful of exceptional companies each year.

As part of our thematic work, we've been spending more time within wealth management, and I think the CRM is structurally the wrong place to build the client relationship. It only captures the cleaned-up version an advisor enters after the fact, while the real context lives across meetings, calls, emails, and follow-up. Continuum can become the living memory of the relationship, then use that context to drive the next action and the client-facing experience, leaving the CRM as the place where the final record gets stored. We've seen this pattern across other industries and my Principal, Chris was very close to the early investments in Rilla and Siro.
